name: SPARTIX Master Hook
description: Master governance hook for .spartix-governed projects. Enforces dotload, workflow transparency, wiki-before-execution gate, task packet review, frontend quality gates, and agent self-awareness.

hooks.name: Session Bootstrap Enforcement
hooks.description: Ensures dotload sequence and historical context check are performed at session start

hooks.name: Workflow Transparency Enforcement
hooks.description: Ensures all agent transitions produce visible structured workflow updates

hooks.name: Task Packet Review Gate
hooks.description: Ensures task packets are reviewed for completeness and step-by-step readiness before approval

hooks.name: Wiki-Before-Execution Gate
hooks.description: Blocks specialist execution until wiki update with approved task state is confirmed

hooks.name: Workspace Safety Check
hooks.description: Verifies workspace location, file targeting, dependency awareness, command plan, and testing plan before execution

hooks.name: Frontend Quality Gate
hooks.description: Ensures frontend tasks include issue investigation, classification, validation, and quality confirmation

hooks.name: Specialist Boundary Enforcement
hooks.description: Ensures specialists do not talk to user, assign next role, hand off to other specialists, or write to wiki

hooks.name: Enhanced Completion Reporting
hooks.description: Ensures completion reports include full workspace reporting with all required detail

hooks.name: Wiki Categorization Enforcement
hooks.description: Ensures wiki updates are written into correct categories

hooks.name: Historical Context Check
hooks.description: Ensures historical project context is checked at session start

hooks.name: Agent Self-Awareness Gate
hooks.description: Blocks execution if agent has not confirmed: identity, specialization, project role, task receipt, expected delivery, workflow position, handoff boundaries, and reporting path
